seconds_left.description: Null when approvals have no timeout.

jwt.description: A fresh gateway JWT. Only a fingerprint is echoed back.

where.description: What failed, when it was not the run itself.

seconds_left.description: Null when approvals have no timeout.

GateAutoApproval.description: An approval decided by the `auto_safe` policy, not by a person.

GatePayload.description: One of several shapes, told apart by `kind`.

GatePhase.description: A migration phase closed and the gate is deferred until the last one.

GateRoutes.description: The route inventory was saved before a migration touched anything.

GateRun.description: The verification gate ran: `inner` over the files just changed, `full` at the end.

cached.description: A full gate answered from its last run.

skipped.description: Why the stage did not run. Empty when it ran.

content.description: Only for a stage that failed.

Health.description: The fields after `version` need the token and are absent without it.

toolchain.description: Tool → version, `installed` when it has no readable version, null when missing. Absent until probed, shortly after start.

HeartbeatPayload.description:
Declared and never emitted. The stream keeps itself alive with SSE comment
frames (`: keep-alive`), which are not events.

MetricsPayload.description: What the whole run cost and where it ran out of room. Sent once, before `end`.

protected.description: Computed by the runtime. Never recompute it client-side.

QuotaPayload.description: A signal to re-read `GET /v1/quota`. It carries no numbers on purpose.

turns.description: First and last turn the recap covers.

queued.description: Corrections typed during the run and not yet read.

turns.description: Messages the developer has sent in this conversation.

queued.description: Corrections typed during the run and not yet read.

turns.description: Messages the developer has sent in this conversation.

SteerPayload.description: A correction the running loop has read.

approval_policy.description: `interactive` (the default): a person answers every approval. `auto_safe`: decided by rule, for a caller with nobody to ask; protected files, deletions and new dependencies are refused.

TextPayload.description: `assistant` (the whole reply) and `assistant_delta` (a streamed piece of it).

arguments.description: As the model sent them, parsed when they parse.

ToolCatalog.description: Contract C1. The published copy is `api/tool-catalog.json`.

ToolPendingPayload.description: An approval being raised. `id` is what `POST /v1/approvals/{id}` takes.

ToolResultPayload.description:
A tool call's outcome, or a call that was answered without being run.

`mutations` is absent when nothing was dispatched: a call skipped, refused
for the output limit, or answered from a ledger.

dispatched.description: False when the call never ran.

hooked.description: A hook answered in the tool's place.

intercepted.description: Answered from a ledger. `ok` stays true: the content is current.

intent_source.description: Whether a person chose the intent or it was classified.

attempt.description: The attempt about to be made: 1, then 2 after a failed gate.

cached_tokens.description: Null until the endpoint reports it. Show it as not reported, not as 0%.

reasoning_leaked.description: Only on the anomaly: reasoning charged in a thinking-off mode.

UserPayload.description: A message the developer sent: the task, a follow-up or a correction.

ValidationFailure.description: FastAPI's own 422, for a path or query parameter of the wrong type.

WireEvent.description: One stored event (C2). `type` is a lower bound: ignore unknown types.

token.description: The loopback token the extension passes to the runtime at spawn.
